key_impacts: Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power units were damaged, triggering long-term decommissioning.
Large volumes of contaminated water were generated, requiring treatment and storage.
About 1,100,000 m3 of treated water was stored on-site by October 2018.
evidence_snippets: Following the accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS) on 11 March 2011
addressing the situation of the damaged plants of Fukushima Daiichi
As of October 2018, about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water is stored on-site
